Scenario fixture: title-placeholder-identical

Each target has a stable id of the form tpi_case_NN. RGAA's glossary entry "Étiquette de champ de formulaire" requires a field's title and placeholder, when both are present, to be identical.

A. Title and placeholder differ (CANTTELL)

01 — CANTTELL: labelled field whose title and placeholder differ
02 — CANTTELL: textarea whose title and placeholder differ
03 — CANTTELL: the two differ only by case

B. Title and placeholder identical (PASS)

04 — PASS: identical values
05 — PASS: identical once whitespace is collapsed

C. Out of scope (NOT APPLICABLE)

06 — NOT APPLICABLE: placeholder only
07 — NOT APPLICABLE: a checkbox shows no placeholder
